accepted_findings: The deliverable defines a prospective protocol; missing independent calibration anchors remain missing and all four production parameter values remain null.

The four dimensionless groups and their inverse distinguish mechanical magnitude, kinetic bias and fuel affordability. Native net-conversion overhead and the inverse effort-duration price do not identify epsilon_A.

The eighty-row force design has four fixed training rows and seventy-six held-out rows. Joint interval estimation uses all training observations, retains correlations and does not refit or shrink the region after holdouts.

A sealed deterministic midpoint of the certified lambda projection selects kinetic fixture geometry only; the full joint parameter region and geometry uncertainty remain in g and theta, with sign ambiguity inconclusive.

The net-rate theta inversion has the stated algebraic sign and requires independently observed unclipped rates, nonzero loads of both signs, refinement bounds and held-out support. It does not infer gross turnover or detailed balance.
Fuel calibration requires an independently owned work-producing channel and separately observed A/W, excluding circular top-up arithmetic and duplicate mechanical donors.
Simultaneous force work includes crosswork. Coupling release is not generally terminal drag heat, and positive loading cannot acquire a second unnamed fuel-work input.

The exact two-spring release witness gives DeltaEc=-19/800, legacy storage gain=11/800 and drag=1/100. The loading witness gives DeltaEc=11/200, legacy release=19/200 and drag=1/25. Their restricted mathematical roles are explicit.

Signed-tension rejection, the fixed external-force cap, explicit/projection integration and possible negative tangential Hessian are correctly distinguished from a certified native discrete-gradient solver.
A-dependent pressure and actuator funding require a justified prospective reservation, force-evaluation, debit and commit order; stale-force replay after changing A is not same-state parity.

Accuracy budgets, tightness bounds, complete uncertainty propagation, input identities, domain and solver policies must be sealed before observations. Zero inclusion alone cannot pass an equality gate.

Current naive adapters are rejected without claiming universal candidate impossibility. All later calibration, physical port realization, native qualification and implementation require separate evidence and authorization.
resolved_review_findings: Specified the complete joint training-region intersection instead of leaving favorable pivot selection possible.
Specified deterministic probe selection from interval-valued lambda and preserved full parameter correlations rather than treating an enclosure as an exact estimate.
Replaced zero-containing residual intervals as a pass rule with independently sealed accuracy and enclosure-tightness requirements.
Explicitly classified the checker floating sqrt/log inversion as a synthetic smoke check, not a prospective numerical qualification certificate.
Bound the specification schema, null values, dimensional groups, fixed design coverage, decision inventory, exact fixtures and scientific claim boundaries in the checker.
limitations: Acceptance verifies specification consistency and static reference witnesses, not actual calibration, physical loading-device availability or native mechanical feasibility.

Synthetic inversion, reduced scalar springs, constant-force cases and verdict assertions do not execute a calibration pipeline or the MaterialMesh solver. Some negative controls illustrate required rejection rules rather than implement future evidence ingestion.

The floating theta smoke comparison uses a fixed local 1e-14 tolerance and supplies no outward-rounded or operation-count qualification certificate. It cannot satisfy the protocol's future floating-evidence gate.

The current checker does not certify contact/complementarity branches, global root existence and uniqueness, full native staging, lifecycle correspondence, finite-fuel rollback or checkpoint behavior.
A scalar unique-root proof does not extend to vertex-coordinate dynamics, and a Newton solution is not an exclusion of other admissible roots.

The accepted conditional energy contract is preserved. Its naive all-release-to-bath/top-up realization is unsupported by simultaneous mechanics; another realization remains unresolved and may require separately authorized architecture work.
No production parameter, runtime feedback, thirty-state correction result, morphogenesis, reproduction, selection, reversal or final lifeform qualification follows from this review.

Parent-owned verifier execution, exact-head hosted CI, artifact reconstruction, source/history preservation checks and Notion/evidence synchronization are separate evidence, not actions performed by this reviewer.
